title: Selling an unlinked government bond or makam before maturity: capital gain up to 15%, all treated as real

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance, s.91(b)(3); Withholding Regulations 2002, reg. 2(b)

rate.notes: Capital gain on selling an unlinked government bond or makam before maturity: maximum rate "שלא יעלה על 15%", the whole gain treated as real (no inflation deduction); 15% withheld. A substantial shareholder pays up to 20%. The Minister may change the rate by order (s.91(b)(3)(b)).
